service.en: Report an employee absent from work
service.ur: ملازم کی غیر حاضری کی شکایت

about: Let an employer report a worker who has stopped coming to work and cannot be reached.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Employee has been absent for more than seven days
Employer does not know where the employee is or cannot reach them
Any late-renewal permit fines must be paid
Approval cancels the work permit automatically, except recruitment-from-abroad and transfer permits
documents: Entry and exit movement report from the federal identity and port authority, dated within the last 30 days
A document from the authorities showing the employee is in the country, if Ministry systems lack their status
